sample_unit: chatbot responses to curated PEG aftercare questions

links.outcome: Recognition of complication red flags and escalation pathways in chatbot responses to PEG questions
links.effect: Responses consistently highlighted clear red-flag signs (infection, tube dislodgement, persistent pain) and specified escalation pathways (self-care, 24-48 h contact, urgent evaluation); no unsafe recommendations identified.
links.quote: Performance was strongest in complication management, where responses consistently highlighted clear red-flag signs (e.g., infection, tube dislodgement, and persistent pain) and specified escalation pathways (self-care, 24-48 h contact, urgent evaluation).

unlisted_practices: Geriatric-focused clinician-informed chatbot design for PEG aftercare education
Frailty-aware and caregiver-oriented stepwise instruction tailoring

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, clinical appropriateness, and safety of a ChatGPT-based chatbot (PEGAssist) for PEG aftercare education using expert clinician ratings of curated questions.
